items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: And then I spoke with the music history professor, Dr. Budds, he’s actually quite brilliant.

ctx.x: If you try to do everything do you risk not having an identity in the music business?

Nope. That’s a good question. That’s such a good question, and it’s something that I have had to answer and ask and question other people about since I was a freshman in college. And it’s been very interesting. I spoke with like this really amazing opera diva extraordinaire, and I said to her, you know, can I take classical technique and just learn how to work my instrument and then like sing in any genre I want? And she looked at me up and down. She was like, “I have no idea what you’re talking about.” Then she…
Do you think it’s harder to rise up in the hierarchy in the opera world or in the jazz world?
